cards.name: Hands On! S.T.E.A.M. Summer Camp
cards.description: Campers explore science, technology, engineering, arts, and mathematics through daily activities. They also tie dye a shirt and explore museum exhibits and the Pollinator Garden.

hours.text: Drop-off: 9:00am. Pick-up: 4:45pm; arriving between 4:30 and 4:45pm is recommended.

lunch.text: Campers need to bring a NUT-FREE lunch with a drink, and two (2) NUT FREE snacks with drinks daily.

cards.review_notes: Weeks omit the year; 2026 is taken from the page heading and program-specific age requirements. Program requires age 5 by June 1, 2026 and no older than 13 on July 31, 2026; general fine print instead references 2025. General policies conflict on late-pickup fees ($25 versus $20). Check-in instructions specify the Pollinator Garden entrance gate, while stale fine print says inside the building.

cards.name: Paleontology Summer Camp
cards.description: Campers dig daily at Gray Fossil Site, tour the fossil site, preparatory lab, and collections room, and explore geosciences and life sciences. Activities also include museum exploration, a Tesla Coil show, and shirt tie dyeing.
